title: Impact of miR-223-3p and miR-2909 on Inflammatory Factors in Human Adipose Stem Cells
author: Juan Wu

steps.title: Seed adipose stem cells (96‑well)
steps.instruction: Prepare a cell suspension at ~1 × 10⁵ cells · mL⁻¹ and add 100 µL to each well of a 96‑well plate; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Reach >80 % confluence
steps.instruction: Allow cells to grow until the fusion (confluence) rate exceeds 80 % before any treatment.

steps.title: Prepare LPS stock solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.0102 g LPS in 10 mL PBS to obtain a 1 g · L⁻¹ stock; dilute this stock with complete medium to working concentrations of 1 µg · mL⁻¹, 10 µg · mL⁻¹ and 100 µg · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Stimulate cells with LPS
steps.instruction: Remove spent medium with a pipette; add 100 µL of each LPS concentration (1, 10, 100 µg · mL⁻¹) to the appropriate wells; incubate for 2 h, 6 h, and 12 h.

steps.title: Add control medium
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of complete medium to control wells; perform all treatments in triplicate.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and cell pellets
steps.instruction: At each time point, transfer supernatant to a 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge 4 °C, 3000 rpm, 10 min; store supernatant at –20 °C for ELISA. Process the cell pellet: (a) extract RNA, reverse‑transcribe to cDNA and store at –20 °C for qPCR; (b) denature protein sample at 100 °C, 10 min, store at –20 °C for western blot; (c) keep a portion for protein quantification.

steps.title: Perform CCK‑8 assay (acute)
steps.instruction: After 2, 6, and 12 h treatments, discard medium, add 10 µL CCK‑8 reagent plus 100 µL fresh medium to each well; read absorbance at 450 nm and plot cell growth versus time.

steps.title: Seed cells for chronic model (6‑well)
steps.instruction: Transfer 1000 adipose stem cells into each well of a 6‑well plate; after 24 h culture, add 100 µL of 1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS to each well (four groups).

steps.title: First chronic stimulation sampling
steps.instruction: After 5 days, collect half of the supernatant for ELISA, centrifuge, and keep the cell pellet for qPCR and protein analysis; add 10 µL CCK‑8 + 100 µL medium, measure absorbance at 450 nm and plot growth curve.

steps.title: Replace medium in remaining groups
steps.instruction: For the three remaining groups, collect half of the supernatant, centrifuge, and replace the withdrawn volume with fresh complete medium.

steps.title: Second LPS stimulation (chronic)
steps.instruction: After 1 day, aspirate medium, add 100 µL of 1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS to fresh medium, then add the previously collected half‑supernatant back to each well.

steps.title: Second chronic sampling
steps.instruction: After an additional 5 days, repeat supernatant‑half collection for ELISA, pellet processing for qPCR and protein, and CCK‑8 assay as in step 9.

steps.title: Third LPS stimulation (chronic)
steps.instruction: For the two remaining groups, repeat half‑supernatant collection, replace with fresh medium, then after 1 day add 100 µL of 1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS to fresh medium and return the saved half‑supernatant.

steps.title: Third chronic sampling
steps.instruction: After another 5 days, repeat ELISA, qPCR/protein, and CCK‑8 measurements as before.

steps.title: Fourth LPS stimulation (chronic)
steps.instruction: For the last group, repeat half‑supernatant collection, replace with fresh medium, then after 1 day add 100 µL of 1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS to fresh medium and return the saved half‑supernatant.

steps.title: Fourth chronic sampling
steps.instruction: After a final 5 day culture, collect half‑supernatant for ELISA, process pellets for qPCR and protein, and perform CCK‑8 assay as described earlier.

steps.title: Select samples for sequencing
steps.instruction: Choose cells from the optimal acute model (1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS, 6 h) and optimal chronic model (1 µg · mL⁻¹ LPS, 4 weeks) together with untreated controls; send for high‑throughput miRNA sequencing.

steps.title: Validate sequencing results
steps.instruction: Generate heat‑maps of miRNA expression and verify selected miRNAs by qPCR.

steps.title: Predict miRNA target genes
steps.instruction: Use 12 databases (miRWalk, Microt4, miRanda, mirbridge, miRDB, miRMap, miRNAMap, Pictar2, PITA, RNA22, RNAhybrid, TargetScan); retain targets supported by ≥9 databases; perform GO analysis with DAVID v6.7 and KEGG pathway analysis.

steps.title: Venn diagram of predictions
steps.instruction: Aggregate predictions from TargetScan, CLIP‑Seq, miRDB, and miRanda to generate Venn diagrams of common target genes.

steps.title: Functional enrichment of targets
steps.instruction: Conduct GO and KEGG pathway analyses for target genes of differentially expressed miRNAs in (a) acute vs control and (b) chronic vs control comparisons.

steps.title: Identify key miRNA‑mRNA interactions
steps.instruction: Determine that miR‑223‑3p binds STAT3 and IL6 3′‑UTRs, miR‑2909 binds KLF4 3′‑UTR; use JASPAR (score ≥ 85) to locate seven TLR4 and four TLR2 promoter binding sites within the STAT3 coding region.

steps.title: Construct reporter plasmids
steps.instruction: Amplify human STAT3, IL6, and KLF4 3′‑UTRs and clone into pMIR‑TM, psi‑CHECK2, and pMIR‑GFP vectors respectively; mutate binding sites via site‑directed mutagenesis and verify by sequencing. Insert STAT3 coding sequence into pLVX‑IRES‑Puro; clone TLR4 and TLR2 promoters into PGL3 vectors; generate corresponding mutant controls.

steps.title: Transfect cells with miR‑223‑3p reagents
steps.instruction: Seed 2 × 10⁵ cells in 0.5 mL per well of a 24‑well plate; incubate overnight (37 °C, 5 % CO₂). Transfect using Lipofectamine 2000 with one of the following: miR‑223‑3p mimic, miR‑223‑3p inhibitor, mimic NC, inhibitor NC. After 24 h, collect supernatant for ELISA and process pellets for RNA (cDNA), protein (denature 100 °C, 10 min) and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Transfect cells with si‑STAT3
steps.instruction: Repeat the seeding and overnight incubation as above; transfect with si‑h‑STAT3 or si‑h‑STAT3 NC using Lipofectamine 2000. After 24 h, collect supernatant and pellets as in step 22.

steps.title: Transfect cells with STAT3 overexpression or inhibition
steps.instruction: Seed and incubate cells as above; transfect with virus‑infected STAT3 or p‑STAT3 inhibitor plasmids using Lipofectamine 2000. After 24 h, collect supernatant and pellets as in step 22.

steps.title: Transfect cells with cytokine/siRNA treatments
steps.instruction: Seed and incubate cells as above; transfect with si‑h‑IL‑6, si‑h‑TNF‑α, their respective NCs, or treat with recombinant IL‑6 or TNF‑α using Lipofectamine 2000 per manufacturer’s protocol. After 24 h, collect supernatant and pellets as in step 22.

steps.title: Transfect cells with miR‑2909 reagents
steps.instruction: Seed and incubate cells as above; transfect with miR‑2909 mimic, miR‑2909 inhibitor, mimic NC, or inhibitor NC using Lipofectamine 2000. After 24 h, collect supernatant and pellets as in step 22.

steps.title: Dual‑luciferase reporter assay
steps.instruction: Co‑transfect adipose stem cells with the appropriate 3′‑UTR reporter plasmid (wild‑type or mutated) and the corresponding miRNA mimic/inhibitor or control plasmid; incubate 24 h; measure firefly and Renilla luciferase activities using the Promega dual‑luciferase reporter assay kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
